facts: VUops.cpp: individual opcode bodies and VUREGS metadata establish register fields, selected lanes and memory transfer widths
Both micro interpreters execute upper before publishing I-immediate and use pre-upper inputs for conflicting lower reads
E sets a two-pair countdown; a consecutive E resets it; branch target is installed after one delay pair
Branch-in-delay, M/D/T environment, unit-dependent address wrap and pipeline timing are deliberately unresolved
Pinned interpreters compare whole nonzero VFwrite metadata, regardless of lane masks; same destination discards the entire lower instruction including secondary VI/memory effects
Conflicting lower VF reads use a saved whole pre-upper VF; CLIP lower writes are discarded and CLIP lower reads use saved flags; other flag pipelines remain unresolved

Pending branch installation precedes E stop; outer Execute resolves a branch initiated in the E-delay pair before stopped-unit return; both local and outer states are recorded as reference models, not hardware claims
